"""The propose add review queue must not drop candidates in silence.

Adding a handle is human gated, so this queue is the ONLY surface on which a newly productive non
roster voice can ever be seen. A cap that shortens the list without reporting the drop makes the
tail invisible and permanent: those handles have no other route into the roster, and nothing in the
report says they existed. The queue is already filtered by propose_add_min_count, and that gate is
the only thing allowed to remove a candidate.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import importlib

from lib import parse_ts

Y = importlib.import_module("yield")

NOW = parse_ts("2026-08-28T12:00:00Z")
ROSTER = {"schema_version": 1, "entries": []}


def _cards():
    recs = []
    for i in range(25):
        h = "voice%02d" % i
        for n in (1, 2):
            recs.append({"opportunity_id": "op-%s-%d" % (h, n),
                         "first_seen": "2026-08-26T00:00:00Z",
                         "last_seen": "2026-08-26T00:00:00Z",
                         "track": "dev-tools",
                         "evidence": [{"origin_handle": h,
                                       "url": "https://x.com/%s/%d" % (h, n)}]})
    return recs


def test_every_qualifying_candidate_reaches_the_review_queue():
    out = Y.decide_propose_add(ROSTER, _cards(), [], Y.yield_cfg({}), NOW)
    assert len(out) == 25
    assert {c["handle"] for c in out} == {"voice%02d" % i for i in range(25)}
    assert all(c["count"] == 2 for c in out)


def test_the_run_yield_report_carries_the_whole_queue_too():
    rep = Y.run_yield(ROSTER, _cards(), [], cfg={}, now=NOW)
    assert len(rep["propose_add"]) == 25


def test_the_min_count_gate_is_the_only_thing_that_removes_a_candidate():
    """Negative control: a one card voice is still excluded, so the queue is filtered, not merely
    long."""
    recs = _cards()
    recs.append({"opportunity_id": "op-once", "first_seen": "2026-08-26T00:00:00Z",
                 "last_seen": "2026-08-26T00:00:00Z", "track": "dev-tools",
                 "evidence": [{"origin_handle": "onceonly",
                               "url": "https://x.com/onceonly/1"}]})
    out = Y.decide_propose_add(ROSTER, recs, [], Y.yield_cfg({}), NOW)
    assert "onceonly" not in {c["handle"] for c in out}
    assert len(out) == 25
why_realistic: The roster pull planner already shipped an unreported per run cap once, which is why the suite now insists a truncation names every dropped handle. The propose add queue has no such assertion, and it is the only surface a non roster voice can ever appear on, so a quiet top 20 cut removes candidates permanently while the report still reads as the complete queue.
